title: Apixaban/rivaroxaban Versus Aspirin for primary prevention of thrombo-embolic complications in JAK2V617F-positive myeloproliferative neoplasms
official: Apixaban/rivaroxaban Versus Aspirin for primary prevention of thrombo-embolic complications in JAK2V617F-positive myeloproliferative neoplasms
summary: Main objective: To demonstrate that low-dose DOAC is more effective than LDA in the primary prevention of arterial or venous thrombosis in JAK2V617F-positive high-risk MPN patients
conditions: Philadelphia-negative myeloproliferative neoplasms are frequent and chronic myeloid malignancies including Polycythemia Vera (PV), essential thrombocythemia (ET), Primary Myelofibrosis (PMF) and Prefibrotic myelofibrosis (PreMF).

interventions.name: ACIDE ACETYLSALICYLIQUE VIATRIS 100 mg, comprimé gastro-résistant

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patients with diagnosis of Polycythemia Vera or Essential Thrombocythemia or Prefibrotic myelofibrosis according to WHO or BSCH criteria (bone marrow biopsy not compulsory).
2. Patients with JAK2V617F mutation (threshold allele burden > 1%).
3. Patients considered as “high-risk” patients:  - 1°) based on age (> 60-year-old) - 2°) based on thrombotic history (compatible with antithrombotic randomization) but aged ≥ 18-year-old
4. Length of time from MPN diagnostic to inclusion will not exceed 12 months
Exclusion criteria:
1. Contra-indication to aspirin or DOAC due to allergic situation or recent history of major bleeding
2. No appropriate contraception (estrogen contraception or no contraception) in women of childbearing age or breastfeeding woman
3. PS>2 or life expectancy <12 months
4. Formal indication of treatment with LDA or DOAC (thus precluding randomization)
5. Inability to give informed consent
6. Patients under curatorship/guardianship
7. Concomitant use of a strong inhibitor or inducer of CYP3A4 (like Ruxolitinib)
8. Chronic liver disease or chronic hepatitis
9. Renal insufficiency with creatinine <30 ml/mn on Cockcroft and Gault Formula
10. Patient considered at high-risk of bleeding: patients with current or recent major or clinically relevant non major bleeding gastrointestinal or cerebral bleedings
11. Planned pregnancy within 24 months
sponsor: Centre Hospitalier Regional Et Universitaire De Brest
